claims: BIGBANG performed at Coachella 2026 Weekend 1 on Apr 12.
BIGBANG performed at Coachella 2026 Weekend 2 on Apr 19.
BIGBANG's Coachella 2026 sets took place at Outdoor Theatre at Empire Polo Club, Indio, CA.
BIGBANG's Coachella 2026 setlist closed with "Still Life".
